Testing… a random 1 to 3 seconds between two IPs; tap the button again to cancel

Enter IPs or domains that are not in the config, one per line (commas and spaces work too), at most 20. Direct tests IP addresses only and uses the domain of the field above as SNI and Host; Through node puts the IP or domain in place of the chosen node server (the core resolves a domain itself). Every IP is tried 10 times (up to 5 at once, each at most 3 seconds).
Ports (Direct: an IP that works gets a handshake on each of these, separated by spaces or commas)
Download test address (downloaded only when you tap Speed on a row; goes straight to the IP, SNI and Host from the address)
Tap an IP to copy it; tap a ports cell for each port; Test downloads for that row only (at most 10 MB or 5 seconds); the table scrolls sideways, Speed is at the far right
A port that fails may be the IP, or your ISP blocking that port.
No port results for this row (the IP itself failed, or Through node)
